scope: host diagnostic; inherited estimator, codec, model and geometry unchanged

capture.format: expected records are little-endian Q27dIII: index; x16, elapsed, likelihood, prior, total, SOC,v3,h,support_slack,endpoint_slack; flags,phase,available
capture.parity: memcmp every binary64 field and exact integer fields at all 15751 snapshots, including initial; abort immediately on mismatch
capture.checkpoint: FPSH001 plus explicit sizes, ch_bank, lab_input_store, adc12_calibration; initialized host ABI, excludes auxiliary pointer union, result and scratch
capture.counter_semantics: actual reconstruction only; optimizer/proposal/accepted counters zero
capture.qualification: four fabricated online paths versus saved-anchor commit reconstruction, including changed anchors, zero current/time, mixed signs and varying intervals; full bank equality excluding only work counters

arithmetic.rounding: binary64 round-nearest; no fast-math or contraction; nonfinite results unavailable; positive allowance arithmetic rounded upward with nextafter
arithmetic.gamma: gamma_n = n*u/(1-n*u), u=2^-53, with outward operations and n*minimum_subnormal additive allowance
arithmetic.represented: gamma_16384 * cost_absolute_scale plus underflow allowance; committed bank has zero raw records; bound covers evaluation of the stored 37-feature polynomial at fixed binary64 coefficients and x, including coordinate differences/scaling, products, compensated row sums, squares and final compensated sum
arithmetic.represented_count_basis: 703 triangular terms; each term uses at most two coordinate subtractions/divisions, one feature product and one coefficient product; each compensated add has at most six rounded operations; 37 squares and the final compensated sum keep the conservative scalar operation count below 16384
arithmetic.reference: For each computed prediction mu and decoded V: a=up((abs(mu)+abs(V))/sigma), epsilon=guard(8,a), local=up(epsilon*(abs(r)+epsilon/2)+guard(4,cost)), r=fl((mu-V)/sigma), cost=fl(0.5*r*r). Upward sum of locals plus guard(8*N+32, upward_sum_of_computed_costs) bounds residual formation, squaring and compensated accumulation
exclusions: continuous-region, normalization, tail or coverage guarantees
arithmetic.qualification: 60-digit Decimal evaluation of stored polynomials and exact-real residual squares from emitted computed operands; separately check original recurrence against a Decimal physical-state recurrence on fabricated cases

supervisor.reservation: exclusive fsynced scientific_reservation.json before capture; never deleted after failure
gates: closed hashed node set before reference
supervisor.limits: inherited plan caps; single sequential child, process-group termination, CPU/AS/file-size rlimits, wall/output/live-RSS polling, wait4 accounting, fsynced logs with distinct-inode verified copies
supervisor.failure: unresolved receipt; no retries, tolerance widening, regenerated inputs or adaptive node changes

future_user_objective.request: Once development is stable, run configurable cell-load-noise-duration trajectories to assess longer-term variation
future_user_objective.sequence: close current finite diagnostic first; retain stable source/input contracts for a separately registered trajectory runner
